experience.description: Redesigned duplicate slot-address validation in Kotlin, replacing one bus-level warning with per-device errors linked to each conflicting profile so users can identify and correct the issue. Corrected a topology lookup defect that could return the first topology instead of the device’s actual topology; added 3 unit tests, updated 4 browser-based end-to-end cases, and merged the branch after CI and SonarQube checks passed. Took ownership of a senior developer’s in-progress performance optimization during their absence, learned the existing implementation, and delivered it 4 days ahead of schedule.

experience.description: Automated 3 recurring manual regression cases in TypeScript, published the browser tests through Jenkins, and validated successful execution across qTest runs. experience.description: Built a MATLAB/Simulink workflow that added visual model comparisons to GitLab, reducing developers’ manual comparison work and earning adoption by 2 additional engineering teams. experience.organization: Rice University ECE & Baylor College of Medicine
experience.description: Built a Python/XGBoost pipeline using wearable and smartphone features from a 26-participant, 90-day depression study; used leave-one-subject-out cross-validation to prevent participant leakage and achieved 0.74 AUC at baseline. Analyzed clinical, quality-of-life, and wearable measures to identify a statistically significant relationship between limb-threat severity and toe-brachial index; coauthored a Journal of Vascular Surgery publication from the Rice-Baylor collaboration.
